name: giga-skills
description: A collection of skills for agentic engineering, technical writing, and agent harness work — including scaffolded, customizable tech-writing skill templates.

plugins.name: agentic-work
plugins.description: Skills for designing, building, and evaluating agentic systems — agent-as-function refactoring and audits, fractal orchestrator architectures, workflow evals, skill and agent creation, task-graph planning, and autonomous loops.

plugins.name: general
plugins.description: General-purpose working skills — iterative deep research and handling files too large to read in one pass.

plugins.name: harnesses
plugins.description: Skills for working with specific agent harnesses — Copilot CLI debug log analysis, extension development, and patching.

plugins.name: tech-writing
plugins.description: Scaffolds customizable tech-writing skills into your project — release notes, hotfix notes, docs-vs-source validation, and draw.io diagram authoring — filled in with your product's specifics.
